entities.name: Mobility from NR procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated mobility procedure for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state, triggered by measurement reports or MCG failure information.

entities.name: MobilityFromNRCommand message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate mobility from NR procedure.

entities.name: MeasurementReport message
entities.description: Message that may trigger the mobility from NR procedure.

entities.name: MCGFailureInformation message
entities.description: Message that may trigger the mobility from NR procedure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where the UE must be for mobility from NR procedure initiation.

entities.name: AS security activated
entities.description: Condition requiring AS security to be activated before procedure initiation.

entities.name: SRB2 and DRB setup condition
entities.description: Condition requiring SRB2 with at least one DRB to be setup and not suspended.

entities.name: No DAPS bearer configured
entities.description: Condition requiring that no DAPS bearer is configured for procedure initiation.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by sending MobilityFromNRCommand message.
Procedure may be triggered by MeasurementReport message.
Procedure may be triggered by MCGFailureInformation message.
Procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure initiation is guarded by AS security activation requirement.
Procedure initiation is guarded by SRB2 and DRB setup requirement.
Procedure initiation is guarded by absence of DAPS bearer configuration.
